name: Siping Juyuan Welded Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
full_description: Siping Juyuan Welded Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd. traces its roots to the Welded Plate Division established by Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Equipment Co., Ltd. in 1998. Since its inception, the team has focused on the research and development of fully welded plate heat exchanger technology, process, and structure.

The company offers a broad range of fully welded heat exchange products with new technologies, processes, and structures. According to the official company profile, these products are used to provide individualized and specialized solutions for military, nuclear, biomass, power, petroleum, chemical, metallurgical, shipbuilding, central heating, air conditioning and refrigeration, food and beverage, seawater desalination, and distributed energy applications.

The company states that it relies on customer resources together with big data and Internet of Things concepts to build a product operation parameter database and a product life cycle service system, while continuing to improve its products, innovation capability, and service quality.
advantages: Long-term specialization in welded plate heat exchanger technology dating back to the original welded plate division established in 1998.
Broad welded product portfolio covering multiple structures such as plate-frame, wide-channel, and specialized cooling applications.
Application coverage across power, petrochemical, marine, HVAC, food and beverage, and other industrial sectors mentioned on the official website.
Official company profile highlights ongoing research, process innovation, and structural innovation for fully welded heat exchange products.
The company states that it uses product operation data and lifecycle service concepts to support more tailored industrial solutions.
